points: Preheat your oven to 220°C/200°C fan/gas mark 7. Boil a full kettle.
Meanwhile, chop the potatoes into 2cm chunks (no need to peel).
Pour the boiling water into a large saucepan with1/2 tsp salt for the potatoes.
Add the potatoes to the water and cook until you can easily slip a knife through, 15-18 mins.
If you'd prefer to boil your green beans, skip the oven.
steps.title: Get Started

points: Meanwhile, trim the carrot, then halve lengthways (no need to peel). Slice widthways into thin pieces about 1/2cm thick.
Trim the green beans.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on medium-high heat.
Once hot, add the beef mince and carrot.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw mince.

steps.title: Prep the Veg

points: Fry until the mince has browned, 5-6 mins. Use a spoon to break it up as it cooks.
While the mince and veg fry, spread the green beans out on a medium baking tray. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
When the oven is hot, roast the green beans on the top shelf until tender, 8-10 mins.
If you'd prefer to boil your green beans, boil them while the mince fries for 4-6 mins, until tender.
steps.title: Get Frying

points: When the mince has browned, drain and discard any excess fat. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir in the tomato puree, red wine jus paste, Worcester sauce, beef stock paste, sugar and water for the sauce (see pantry for both amounts).
Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until thickened, 3-4 mins.

notes.text: The mince is cooked when no longer pink in the middle.
If your red wine jus paste has hardened, put the sachet in a bowl of hot water for 1 min to loosen.

steps.title: Build the Flavour

points: Once the potatoes are cooked, drain in a colander and return to the pan, off the heat. Add a knob of butter and a splash of milk (if you have any) and mash until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper. Cover with a lid to keep warm.
steps.title: Mash Time

points: Share the mashed potato between your serving bowls.
Spoon the beef over the mash.
Sprinkle over the grated hard Italian style cheese.
Serve the green beans alongside.
steps.title: Serve
